Here's a JSON schema for a beta cruiser:

```json
{
  "$schema": "http://json-schema.org/draft-07/schema#",
  "title": "Beta Cruiser",
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "name": {
      "type": "string",
      "description": "name of the beta cruiser"
    },
    "class": {
      "type": "string",
      "description": "class of the beta cruiser (e.g. destroyer, cruiser, etc.)"
    },
    "size": {
      "type": "number",
      "description": "size of the beta cruiser in meters"
    },
    "speed": {
      "type": "number",
      "description": "speed of the beta cruiser in km/h"
    },
    "armament": {
      "type": "array",
      "description": "list of armaments on the beta cruiser",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "properties": {
          "type": {
            "type": "string",
            "description": "type of armament (e.g. gun, missile, etc.)"
          },
          "caliber": {
            "type": "string",
            "description": "caliber of the armament (e.g. 5-inch, 10-inch, etc.)"
          },
          "quantity": {
            "type": "number",
            "description": "quantity of the armament"
          }
        },
        "required": ["type", "caliber", "quantity"]
      }
    },
    "crew": {
      "type": "object",
      "properties": {
        "size": {
          "type": "number",
          "description": "size of the crew"
        },
        "composition": {
          "type": "array",
          "description": "list of crew members",
          "items": {
            "type": "object",
            "properties": {
              "name": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "name of the crew member"
              },
              "role": {
                "type": "string",
                "description": "role of the crew member (e.g. pilot, gunner, etc.)"
              }
            },
            "required": ["name", "role"]
          }
        }
      },
      "required": ["size", "composition"]
    },
    "engines": {
      "type": "array",
      "description": "list of engines on the beta cruiser",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "properties": {
          "type": {
            "type": "string",
            "description": "type of engine (e.g. diesel, nuclear, etc.)"
          },
          "power": {
            "type": "number",
            "description": "power of the engine in horsepower"
          }
        },
        "required": ["type", "power"]
      }
    },
    "sensors": {
      "type": "array",
      "description": "list of sensors on the beta cruiser",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "properties": {
          "type": {
            "type": "string",
            "description": "type of sensor (e.g. radar, sonar, etc.)"
          },
          "[range]": {
            "type": "number",
            "description": "range of the sensor in meters"
          }
        },
        "required": ["type", "[range]"]
      }
    }
  },
  "required": ["name", "class", "size", "speed", "armament", "crew", "engines", "sensors"]
}
```

This schema defines a beta cruiser with various properties, including name, class, size, speed, armament, crew, engines, and sensors. The armament, crew, engines, and sensors properties are arrays of objects, where each object represents a specific armament, crew member, engine, or sensor. The sensors property has a placeholder for the range of the sensor, represented by `[range]`.<|eot_id|>
